method: Researched at build time (WP-19, TERMINAL_DESIGN.md s13.13) with web search; every post_money_usd / price_per_share carries the source_url and as_of of the report it was read from, or is null. Nothing is estimated: a per-share price is recorded only when a cited source states one; 'post_money_basis' says whether the source labelled the figure post-money. Rows are seeded once (INSERT OR IGNORE) and owner-recorded rounds are never overwritten. Listing status re-verified on 2026-10-21 with web search for every company: PUBLIC needs the ticker, the listing venue (exchange), the first trade date (listed_on) and a listing_source_url; FILED_IPO needs a cited filing (status_source_url, status_as_of) and stays until the shares trade; 'acquired' records a completed acquisition with its effective date and source, after which the company is no longer privately traded.

fields.status: PRIVATE | FILED_IPO | PUBLIC (+ ticker; the mark switches to the listed instrument from listed_on)
fields.post_money_usd: integer US dollars as the cited source reports the valuation (see post_money_basis), or null
fields.price_per_share: decimal string per share as the cited source reports it, or null (valuation-only rows have no mark)
fields.as_of: the date of the cited report
fields.exchange: PUBLIC only: the listing venue as the issuer or the exchange names it (e.g. Nasdaq Global Select Market)
fields.listed_on: PUBLIC only: the first trade date of the listed shares
fields.listing_source_url: PUBLIC only: the exchange notice or issuer release naming the venue, the ticker and the first trade date
fields.first_trade_source_url: PUBLIC only: a report of the first trading day
fields.status_source_url: the cited filing or report behind the status (FILED_IPO: the confidential or public registration statement)
fields.status_as_of: the date of that filing or report
fields.acquired: {by, acquirer_ticker, on, source_url}: a completed acquisition; from 'on' the company is no longer privately traded

companies.name: Anthropic PBC
companies.notes: USD 65 bn raised (about USD 15 bn previously committed hyperscaler capital, incl. USD 5 bn from Amazon). Prior round: Series G, Feb 2026, USD 30 bn at USD 380 bn post-money (GIC, Coatue). No price per share disclosed. Confidentially submitted a draft Form S-1 to the SEC (company announcement, 2026-06-01); no public listing as of 2026-10-21.

last_round.post_money_basis: post-money as stated by the source
last_round.lead_investors: Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, Sequoia Capital

companies.name: OpenAI
companies.notes: USD 122 bn committed (target was 110 bn). Amazon anchored with a USD 50 bn commitment of which 35 bn is contingent on an IPO or an AGI milestone; Nvidia and SoftBank USD 30 bn each; a16z, D. E. Shaw Ventures, MGX, TPG and T. Rowe Price accounts also participated. No price per share disclosed. Announced on 2026-06-08 that it had confidentially submitted a draft Form S-1 to the SEC; no public listing as of 2026-10-21.

last_round.post_money_basis: post-money as stated by the source

companies.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (SpaceX)
companies.notes: IPO priced 2026-06-11 at USD 135 per share (555,555,555 Class A shares, about USD 75 bn raised, about USD 1.77 tn at the offer price); trading on Nasdaq Global Select Market and Nasdaq Texas from 2026-06-12 as SPCX, so the mark comes from the listed instrument. Last private mark: insider share sale reported by Bloomberg on 2025-12-12 at USD 421 per share, about USD 800 bn. The pre- and post-IPO per-share figures are not comparable (share count changed) and are not reconciled here. Listing verified 2026-10-21: Nasdaq Data Technical News #2026-8 lists SPCX on the Nasdaq Global Select Market (dual listing on Nasdaq Texas) with first trade 2026-06-12; IPOScoop reports the debut that day (open 150.00, close 160.95).

last_round.post_money_basis: market value at the offer price as reported (about USD 1.77 tn)

companies.name: xAI Corp.
companies.notes: Acquired by SpaceX: the merger completed on 2026-02-02 and xAI became a wholly owned SpaceX subsidiary (SpaceX Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30, Note 1); reported at about USD 250 bn. Its shares are no longer separately traded. The Series E (USD 20 bn, upsized from 15 bn) is the last independent round; no single lead was named - participants included Valor Equity Partners, StepStone Group, Fidelity, Qatar Investment Authority, MGX, Baron Capital, Nvidia, Cisco Investments and Tesla. round_date is the report date (the closing date was not stated).

last_round.post_money_basis: described as post-money by secondary trackers; no primary filing seen

companies.name: Stripe, Inc.
companies.notes: Employee liquidity tender announced in Stripe's annual letter (reported 2026-02-24); Thrive Capital, Coatue and a16z provide most of the funds and Stripe repurchases some shares. The per-share price was not confirmed by Stripe: one secondary blog cites USD 63.00 and another site a different figure, so it is left null. Prior tenders: Feb 2025 (USD 91.5 bn), Sep 2025 (USD 106.7 bn).

last_round.post_money_basis: tender valuation as stated by the source

companies.name: Databricks, Inc.
companies.notes: USD 5 bn strategic round closed 2026-08-13 (a July term sheet had said USD 188 bn). The sources do not say whether USD 190 bn is pre- or post-money. New investors Sixth Street Growth, BOND, Clearlake Capital, Point72, Premji Invest, TPG. Prior round: about USD 5 bn at USD 134 bn (Feb 2026). No price per share disclosed.

last_round.post_money_basis: valuation as reported; the source does not label it pre- or post-money
last_round.lead_investors: Coatue (lead); Blackstone, MGX, T. Rowe Price Associates and T. Rowe Price Investment Management

companies.name: Anduril Industries, Inc.
companies.notes: USD 5 bn Series H announced 2026-05-13, led by returning investors Thrive Capital and Andreessen Horowitz; prior Series G (June 2025) USD 2.5 bn at USD 30.5 bn led by Founders Fund. A later report of talks at a USD 100 bn valuation is unconfirmed. No price per share disclosed.

last_round.post_money_basis: valuation as reported by TechCrunch; secondary summaries call it post-money

companies.name: Scale AI, Inc.
companies.notes: Meta invested USD 14.3 bn for a 49 % stake (Reuters, June 2025); Scale said the valuation was USD 29 bn; CEO Alexandr Wang joined Meta. The exact closing day comes from an aggregator (June 13). Claims of a 2026 Series G or an S-1 filing appear on one aggregator only and are unverified. No price per share disclosed.

last_round.post_money_basis: valuation as stated by Scale AI per the source

companies.name: Perplexity AI, Inc.
companies.notes: Secondary-source data (DefiLlama tracker, read 2026-10-21): USD 525 m on 2026-01-09 at a USD 20.4 bn valuation; the round label is the tracker's own. Nvidia was reported in talks (Aug 2026, The Information via Reuters) at more than USD 30 bn - not closed at research time. No lead investor confirmed; no price per share disclosed.

last_round.post_money_basis: valuation as listed by a secondary tracker (DefiLlama)

companies.name: Mistral AI SAS
companies.notes: EUR 3 bn Series D announced 2026-09-08 at a post-money valuation above EUR 21 bn (Orrick, counsel to Mistral); the USD figure (US$ 24.42 bn for EUR 21 bn) is the cited source's conversion. Led by Samsung Electronics with Scaleup Europe Fund (EQT) and PSG Equity as co-leads; ASML (Series C lead) joined. Prior: Series C Sep 2025, EUR 1.7 bn at EUR 11.7 bn post-money. No price per share disclosed.

last_round.post_money_basis: post-money (more than EUR 21 bn) converted to USD by the source
last_round.lead_investors: Samsung Electronics (lead); Scaleup Europe Fund (EQT), PSG Equity (co-leads)

companies.name: Safe Superintelligence Inc.
companies.notes: About USD 2 bn at a USD 32 bn valuation, reported by the Financial Times (TechCrunch relay dated 2025-04-12); never confirmed by SSI. Greenoaks committed USD 500 m; a16z, Lightspeed, DST Global and strategic investors Alphabet and Nvidia also reported. A July 2026 Nvidia strategic investment (USD 5 bn, forecasting-site claim) has no disclosed terms. No price per share disclosed.

last_round.post_money_basis: valuation as reported (FT via TechCrunch); not confirmed by the company

companies.name: Anysphere, Inc. (Cursor)
companies.notes: Acquired by SpaceX: the all-stock merger became effective on 2026-08-14 (implied equity value USD 60.0 bn; 389,289,254 SpaceX Class A shares) per the SpaceX Form 8-K of 2026-08-14, so its shares are no longer separately traded. Last independent round: USD 2.3 bn Series D (announced 2025-11-13/14) co-led by Accel and Coatue with Thrive Capital, a16z, DST, Nvidia and Google. No price per share disclosed.

last_round.post_money_basis: post-money as stated by the company per the source

companies.name: Groq, Inc.
companies.notes: USD 350 m round (the company calls it a Series A) announced 2026-08-17, led by Disruptive with Nvidia's participation planned; Bloomberg: about half the USD 6.9 bn valuation of Sept 2025, after the Nvidia licensing/asset deal and the hiring of founder Jonathan Ross. The source does not say whether USD 3.5 bn is pre- or post-money. USD 650 m was also raised in June 2026 (no valuation disclosed). No price per share disclosed.

last_round.post_money_basis: valuation as reported; pre- or post-money not stated

companies.name: Revolut Ltd
companies.notes: Secondary share sale confirmed by Revolut on 2026-07-22; the price (USD 2,017 per share) and the implied valuation (about USD 115 bn) are press-reported (Bloomberg via tech.eu), not disclosed by the company; buyers reported: Coatue, Greenoaks, Dragoneer, Fidelity; size sought at least USD 750 m. Prior secondary Nov 2025 at USD 75 bn. A Forge indicative price of USD 2,125 (2026-10-15) is not a transaction.

last_round.post_money_basis: implied valuation as reported (about USD 115 bn); not confirmed by the company

companies.name: ByteDance Ltd.
companies.notes: Employee share buyback reported by Reuters on 2025-08-27 (sources): USD 200.41 per share for current employees (former employees USD 180.37 per SCMP), valuing ByteDance at over USD 330 bn; up 5.5 % from USD 189.90 (about USD 315 bn) six months earlier. The repurchase email reached China-based staff on 2025-10-10 (SCMP). No official ByteDance statement.

last_round.post_money_basis: valuation implied by the buyback price as reported (over USD 330 bn)

companies.name: Canva Pty Ltd
companies.notes: Employee share sale launched 2025-08-20 at a USD 42 bn valuation (Bloomberg), up from USD 32 bn in 2024; buyers include Fidelity Management & Research and JPMorgan Asset Management. No 2026 transaction found at research time. No price per share disclosed.

last_round.post_money_basis: valuation as stated by the source
last_round.lead_investors: Fidelity Management & Research, JPMorgan Asset Management (buyers)

companies.name: Epic Games, Inc.
companies.notes: Secondary-source data (DefiLlama tracker, updated 2026-08-25): The Walt Disney Company's USD 1.5 bn investment (Feb 2024) at a USD 22.5 bn valuation; CB Insights dates the deal 2024-02-07. The often-quoted USD 28.7 bn dates from the April 2021 round. No later round found at research time. No price per share disclosed.

last_round.post_money_basis: valuation as listed by a secondary tracker (DefiLlama)

companies.name: Discord Inc.
companies.notes: Confidential US IPO filing reported in January 2026 (Reuters/Bloomberg relays; Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan said to lead). Last priced round: USD 500 m led by Dragoneer on 2021-09-15; the USD 15 bn valuation came from Bloomberg's source and was not confirmed by Discord. Forge secondary data implied about USD 8.5 bn in mid-2026 (indicative, not a transaction). No price per share disclosed. Listing status re-checked 2026-10-21: no public listing found (FILED_IPO stays until the shares trade).

last_round.post_money_basis: valuation as reported by Bloomberg's source; not confirmed by the company

companies.name: Fanatics, Inc.
companies.notes: About USD 700 m raised at a USD 31 bn valuation (announced 2022-12-06), led by Clearlake Capital Group with LionTree; no later primary round found at research time, and later secondary reports suggesting valuation compression are unverified. No price per share disclosed.

last_round.post_money_basis: valuation as stated by the source

companies.name: Payward, Inc. (Kraken)
companies.notes: USD 800 m in two tranches announced 2025-11-18: a primary tranche led by Jane Street, DRW Venture Capital, HSG, Oppenheimer Alternative Investment Management and Tribe Capital (plus the family office of co-CEO Arjun Sethi) and a USD 200 m strategic investment by Citadel Securities at the USD 20 bn valuation. A USD 100 m round at USD 21 bn (Sept 2026, Nasdaq Ventures) appears on one aggregator only - unverified. No price per share disclosed. Kraken announced on 2025-11-19 that it had confidentially submitted a draft Form S-1 to the SEC; CoinDesk reported on 2026-09-02 (one source) that the listing is not planned before Q2 2027. Not trading as of 2026-10-21.

last_round.post_money_basis: valuation as stated by the company per the source
last_round.lead_investors: Jane Street, DRW Venture Capital, HSG, Oppenheimer Alternative Investment Management, Tribe Capital; Citadel Securities (strategic)

companies.name: Ramp Business Corporation
companies.notes: Series F announced 2026-06-04: USD 750 m led by ICONIQ, GIC and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan at a USD 44 bn valuation (the source does not label it pre- or post-money). Bloomberg reported in October 2026 a further about USD 1.85 bn at roughly USD 60 bn PRE-money led by Dragoneer and Thrive Capital, which Ramp has not confirmed - not recorded as a round here. Prior: USD 300 m at USD 32 bn (Nov 2025, Lightspeed). No price per share disclosed.

last_round.post_money_basis: valuation as stated by the source (OTPP); pre- or post-money not stated
last_round.lead_investors: ICONIQ, GIC, Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

companies.name: Rippling People Center Inc.
companies.notes: USD 450 m Series G announced 2025-05-09 (plus a tender offer of up to USD 200 m); the company said there was no lead investor - participants included Elad Gil, Sands Capital, GIC, Goldman Sachs Growth, Baillie Gifford and Y Combinator. Secondary sales around Dec 2025 implied about USD 20.8 bn (tracker data); 'Series H/I' labels on one tracker are unreliable. No price per share disclosed.

last_round.post_money_basis: valuation as confirmed by the company per the source

companies.name: Deel, Inc.
companies.notes: USD 300 m Series E (2025-10-20) at a USD 17.3 bn valuation, co-led by Ribbit Capital with Andreessen Horowitz and Coatue; the source does not label it pre- or post-money. An S-1 filing in Feb 2026 at USD 23.8 bn appears on one unreliable tracker - unverified. Prior: a USD 300 m secondary at USD 12.6 bn (early 2025). No price per share disclosed.

last_round.post_money_basis: valuation as stated by the source; pre- or post-money not stated

companies.name: Vercel Inc.
companies.notes: USD 300 m Series F announced 2025-09-30 at a USD 9.3 bn post-money valuation (company press release), co-led by Accel and GIC with BlackRock, StepStone, Khosla Ventures, Schroders, Adams Street and General Catalyst; an approximately USD 300 m secondary tender closed in November 2025. A 2026 S-1 / Series G claim appears on one unreliable tracker - unverified. No price per share disclosed.

last_round.post_money_basis: post-money as stated by the company press release

companies.name: Cerebras Systems Inc.
companies.notes: IPO priced 2026-05-13 at USD 185 per Class A share (30,000,000 shares, about USD 5.55 bn gross; marketed range 150-160); trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market from 2026-05-14 as CBRS, so the mark comes from the listed instrument. USD 56.4 bn is the fully diluted valuation at the IPO price per Yahoo Finance; the stock closed its first day at USD 311. Last private round: Series H, Feb 2026, USD 1 bn at about USD 23 bn post-money led by Tiger Global. Listing verified 2026-10-21: the company pricing release (2026-05-13) names the Nasdaq Global Select Market, ticker CBRS, trading from 2026-05-14; IPOScoop reports the first trade on 2026-05-14 (open 350.00, close 311.07).

last_round.post_money_basis: fully diluted valuation at the IPO price as reported
